escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("escape_asterisks" = TRUE, "escape_underscores" = FALSE), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
